test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A ? B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,

'A ! B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,

'A & B' means ‘A is the brother of B’ and

'A x B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

Which of the following means that Z is the wife's father's mother of L?

options.text: Z & B ! T x J ? L
Z ! B x T ? J & L
Z ? B x T & J ! L
Z ? B ! T & J x L

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 ?
 !
 &
 x
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Wife
 Brother
 Father
 
 

 to B
 
 

So, by checking each option one by one:

i. Z & B ! T x J ? L → Z is the brother of B who is the wife of T who is the father of J who is the mother of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/145a40dc0ea97e8779f7699fab383fd4a347f0fe21f758fcd633e6420017bd10.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7901b40070bef0a84893ec8bdd85047e9b599740c00f24df46fed38f527e425.png] 

Here, Z is L's mother's maternal uncle.

ii. Z ! B x T ? J & L → Z is the wife of B who is the father of T who is the mother of J who is the brother of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f2025b9e7c64496c6ac497afa761961be3f3152c1b30da7e27acaf4c4988f59.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7bdac7e7d13a56c46a91097a14872d09f67325ce3453b674421a5df6f20eac1.png] 

Here, Z is L's maternal grandmother.

iii. Z ? B x T & J ! L → Z is the mother of B who is the father of T who is the brother of J who is the wife of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1275aecbfb2aff22d64889d30dcd492fb8146b8212dc6ceefaed778da1184422.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/314a0e56a4386966bbb1fac0b46fd7af1a19facf6ad699214ae07275070baee0.png] 

**Here, Z is L's wife's father's mother.**

iv. Z ? B ! T & J x L → Z is the mother of B who is the wife of T who is the brother of J who is the father of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6284a710f882ef6b1c0cd89c21d2bdc25866bf35b4bf932abe0e303977a1ccae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da4fa88b4c632b57885eda777d0f48bcf0ca1a15f76af2da501d8f68630bb023.png] 

Here, Z is L's father's brother's mother-in-law.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
